hash_method: SHA-256 of parsed packet JSON serialized with sorted keys, UTF-8, ensure_ascii=false, compact separators. File whitespace/newline changes do not alter packet identity.

acceptance: Inspect all first judgments, not only preferences. Require located source-based explanations of each known error, stable identification after swaps, and no invented substantive difference in each identical-valid pair. No retries or omission of failed controls; separately record disagreements and unresolved judgments.
limitations: These four authored, public task families are independent real test tasks with disclosed source content and reuse. Translations and order swaps are variants of the same families. The input pack itself is not an execution result. Astra completed the 12 planned first-pass reviews on 2026-10-12; see evals/diagnostics/2026-10-12-astra-calibration for responses, failures, usage and findings. Those results describe this run; they do not establish general reliability or Toolkit efficacy.
